package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/net/idna"
)

var indirectEntry = func() {
	value, err := idna.ToASCII("bücher.example")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(value)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "invoke" {
		invoke(indirectEntry)
	}
}

//go:noinline
func invoke(call func()) { call() }
